title: Что произошло до прибытия
description: Что произошло до прибытия: разбираем конструкцию и её смысл на примерах, в диалоге и авторском тексте без аудирования.
objectives: Показывать более раннее прошлое с had + причастие
notes: Past Perfect (had + причастие) показывает действие, завершившееся раньше другого момента в прошлом.
Past Simple продвигает рассказ; Past Perfect помогает объяснить уже существовавшую ситуацию.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: When Leo reached platform six, the train ___ already left.
exercises.explanation: Поезд ушёл раньше, чем Лео добрался до платформы: had left.

exercises.prompt: Вставь подходящее слово из пары: closed / close.

public_payload.sentence: The ticket office had ___ before we arrived.

exercises.editorial_answer: The ticket office had closed before we arrived.
exercises.explanation: После had требуется причастие closed, а не начальная форма.

exercises.editorial_answer: The passengers had left before the announcement.
exercises.explanation: Had left обозначает более раннее действие, before связывает события.

exercises.prompt: Исправь только ошибку в конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: When we arrived, the bus has already departed.

accepted: When we arrived, the bus had already departed.

exercises.reference_answer: When we arrived, the bus had already departed.
exercises.incorrect_answer: When we arrived, the bus has already departed.
exercises.editorial_answer: When we arrived, the bus had already departed.
exercises.explanation: В рассказе о прошлом более раннее отправление выражается had departed.

exercises.prompt: Почему Лео не сел на поезд?

public_payload.passage: Leo reached the station at ten past eight. His ticket said that the train would leave at eight, but he hoped it was late. On platform six he found only a cleaner. The train had left on time. Leo went to the ticket office and changed his ticket for the next service. He decided to leave home earlier next time.

options.label: The cleaner refused to let him board.
His ticket was for a different station.
It had left before he arrived.

exercises.editorial_answer: It had left before he arrived.
exercises.explanation: Поезд ушёл в восемь, Лео прибыл на десять минут позже.

public_payload.passage: Leo reached the station at ten past eight. His ticket said that the train would leave at eight, but he hoped it was late. On platform six he found only a cleaner. The train had left on time. Leo went to the ticket office and changed his ticket for the next service. He decided to leave home earlier next time.

options.label: He decided never to travel by train again.
He changed his ticket for the next service.
He caught the same train on another platform.

exercises.editorial_answer: He changed his ticket for the next service.
exercises.explanation: Текст прямо сообщает об обмене билета; об отказе от поездок не говорится.

exercises.prompt: Объясни пустые места более ранним событием в прошлом.

lines.speaker: Собеседник
lines.text: Why were the seats empty when you entered?

options.label: The audience will go home tomorrow.
The audience goes home every Friday.
The audience had already gone home.

exercises.editorial_answer: The audience had already gone home.
exercises.explanation: Had already gone объясняет состояние зала к моменту входа.

public_payload.sentence: The train was due to leave at eight. Its scheduled ___ was eight o’clock.

exercises.explanation: Departure обозначает отправление; platform — место, passenger — человек.
